name: Debian Linux
short_description: Debian Linux container with SSH access via username and password.
description: A clean Debian Linux container running an SSH server via the LinuxServer openssh-server image. Set your username and password using environment variables and connect from any SSH client. Ideal as a remote shell, development sandbox, or isolated Linux environment accessible over your network.
usecases: Remote shell access over SSH from any device on the network.
Lightweight Linux development sandbox for running scripts and tools.
Isolated Debian environment for testing and experimentation.
notes: SSH listens on port 2222 inside the container
Password authentication and sudo access are enabled by default
